autodelete.description: Manages keyword auto-delete rules: add, remove, enable, disable, and counters.
autodelete.usage:
autodelete list
autodelete add <word> [| <word> ...]
autodelete remove <id>
autodelete on <id>
autodelete off <id>
autodelete stats [id]
autodelete reset <id>
autoschedule.description: Schedules a recurring message (daily or weekly).
block.description: Blocks a user from contacting the bot on WhatsApp.
calc.description: Calculator: arithmetic, percentages, powers and math functions.
debt.usage:
debt add <amount> [description]
debt del <id>
debt list
deleteschedule.description: Deletes a scheduled message by its ID.
digit.description: Converts numbers between Arabic-Indic (٠١٢) and English (012) digits.
gemini.description: AI assistant with tools (web search, reading links, long-term memory). Sub-commands: add/send/clear/show for context, generate for images, del/delall to clear the conversation.
gemini.usage:
gemini <text>
gemini add <text>
gemini send
gemini show
gemini clear
generate <image description>
del   (clear this chat's conversation)
delall   (clear every conversation)
group.description: Main command for all group management actions.
help.description: Lists every command, or shows the details of one — in Arabic or English.
lang.description: Shows or changes the bot's language.
listschedules.description: Lists all active and pending scheduled messages.
loop.description: Repeats text or numbers — in one message or as separate messages.
md.description: Converts Markdown from any AI or message into WhatsApp formatting, with tables as labeled bullet lists.
md.usage: md <markdown text> | reply to a message with md
memory.description: The bot's long-term memory (.md files): add, list, search, forget, or export the file.
memory.usage:
memory
memory add <fact>
memory add global <fact>
memory search <word>
memory forget <number|part of the text>
memory clear [global]
memory file [global]
mod.usage:
mod status
mod <enable|disable> <antiLink|antiSpam|forbiddenWords>
mod action <antiLink|forbiddenWords> <DELETE|WARN|KICK>
mod action antiSpam <WARN|KICK>
mod words <add|remove> <word>
mod words list
notes.description: Lists all saved note keywords for the group.
pack.description: Create, fill and manage your sticker packs.
pack.usage:
pack <name> (reply to media to add)
pack <name> (show without a reply)
pack create <name>
pack add <name>
pack remove <name>
pack rename <old> | <new>
pack delete <name>
pack show <name>
packs.description: List your sticker packs and library total.
perm.description: Manages bot roles: add or remove an owner or admin, and list the current ones.
perm.usage:
perm list
perm add admin @member
perm add owner <number>
perm remove admin @member
ping.description: Checks that the bot is responding.
poll.description: Creates a poll in the chat.
prayer.description: Shows prayer times for a city.
qr.description: Generates a QR code from text.
rand.description: Random numbers, dice, a coin flip, or a pick from a list.
rand.usage: rand [<max> | <min> <max> | dice [2d6] | coin | pick a | b | c]
restart.description: Reconnects WhatsApp (the process and panel stay up).
schedule.description: Schedules a message to be sent later.
score.description: Shows how many times a message has been forwarded.
send.description: Re-sends the replied message here: a status/story, photo, video, voice note, sticker, document or text.
send.usage: send   (reply to a status or any message with it)
setprefix.description: Sets the bot's command prefix (owner only).
shortlink.description: Shortens up to 5 links with is.gd, falling back to v.gd. Reads a URL from the command or a replied message.
shortlink.usage: shortlink <url> | reply to a message containing a link
sticker.description: Create a sticker from an image, GIF or video.
sticker.usage:
sticker [crop] [nobg] (attach an image, GIF or video)
sticker [crop] [nobg] (reply to media)
sticker (reply to a sticker for PNG)
stickers.description: Browse your recent, favorite or packed stickers.
stickers.usage:
stickers [page]
stickers recent [page]
stickers favorites [page]
stickers pack <name> [page]
stopbot.description: Pauses the WhatsApp connection (the bot process and panel keep running).
stt.description: Converts speech/audio to text (Gemini or Groq/OpenAI Whisper).
stt.usage: stt   (reply to a voice note, or send one with the command)
todo.usage:
todo list
todo add <task>
todo del <task number>
toimage.description: Turn a replied sticker into a PNG or animated video.
toimage.usage:
toimage (reply to a sticker)
toimage doc (reply to a sticker)
toimage gif (reply to an animated sticker)
translate.description: Translates text. Arabic ↔ English by default, or into a chosen language. AI (default) or Google Translate.
translate.usage:
translate <text>
translate <language> <text>
translate google <text>
translate ai <text>
translate summary <text>
translate explain <text>
translate detect [text]
translate formal <text>
translate casual <text>
translate (reply to a message)
tts.description: Converts text to speech (free — no API costs).
tts.usage: tts <text>   (or reply to a text message)
weather.description: Shows the current weather for a city.
group.add.description: Adds a member to the group, or sends an invite if their privacy settings block it.
group.all.description: Mentions every member of the group.
group.antilink.description: Advanced control of the anti-link protection.
group.antilink.usage:
antilink [status]
antilink <on|off>
antilink mode <ALL|WHITELIST|BLACKLIST>
antilink action <DELETE|WARN|KICK>
antilink <allow|disallow> <domain>
group.antispam.usage:
antispam [status]
antispam <on|off>
antispam action <WARN|KICK>
antispam window <seconds>
antispam count <number>
group.approveall.description: Manages automatic approval of join requests.
group.clearwarns.description: Clears all of a member's warnings and dismisses their flag.
group.demote.description: Demotes an admin to a regular member.
group.flagged.description: Lists members waiting for admin review.
group.kick.description: Removes a member from the group.
group.media.description: Controls which message types are allowed in the group.
group.members.description: Lists every member of the group with their number.
group.policy.description: Shows and changes this group's moderation policy.
group.removeall.description: Removes every non-admin member from the group, after confirmation.
group.save.description: Saves a new note for the group.
group.setrules.description: Sets the rules for this group.
group.tagadmins.description: Mentions every admin in the group.
group.warn.description: Warns a member, and takes action once the limit is reached.
group.welcome.usage:
welcome [status]
welcome <on|off>
welcome add <welcome text>
welcome list
welcome delete <number>
